dataset_policy: Existing 20-location historical source retained; Gold excluded.
physical_topology_limitation: All Docker workers share one physical host; this measures logical containerized scale-out.

selected_partition_config.rule: Highest median sustainable pipeline throughput among correctness-passing, calibrated, valid runs; within 2% ties prefer lower p95 latency, lower lag p95, then fewer partitions.

selected_single_worker_config.rule: Highest median sustainable pipeline rate; within 2% ties prefer fewer application cores, then lower latency, lag, and drain.

invalid_short_workload.reason: 500,000 records at 8,000 msg/s ended before the minimum warmup and three-batch steady-state window; no eligible steady-state samples. Excluded from comparisons.

higher_stress_validation.ten_thousand_rate_reason: The calibrated 8,000 msg/s comparison already separated all three valid finalists: baseline median pipeline 8,855.04 rows/s, B1 7,997.26 rows/s, and C1 6,129.94 rows/s. A 10,000 msg/s workload was unnecessary to distinguish these configurations.
higher_stress_validation.interpretation: Targeted higher stress was required because the 5,000 msg/s finalists were mostly UNDER_CAPACITY and differed by only a small margin. At 8,000 msg/s, baseline processed faster than offered input, B1 was near the offered rate, and C1 lagged while the source later drained. One-host results only.
